comment: Parameters 5 to 9 are the unison count, oversample rate, default tuning, output offset and output scale; all five are reached only from the context menu and have no widget on the panel. The menu holds four sliders, labelled by their parameter names Output DC Offset, Scale, Unison and Over Sample Rate, then a Default Tuning heading with the items Audio C4, Clock / Lfo 2hz and Slow Lfo 0.125hz. Default Tuning is a MenuLabel heading rather than a clickable item. The maker configures DEFAULT_TUNING_PARAM with the name 'Over Sample Rate', a copy-paste from the parameter before it, so Rack shows that name twice.
